rounds.text: The evidence provided carries significant weight in building an argument that Cyient Ltd (CYIENT) carries substantial risks and does not support its current valuation. This negative trend contradicts the bullish narrative of the company's fundamentals-led performance [E51], indicating a potential misalignment between reported financial metrics and actual business outcomes. Additionally, the compounded profit growth over five years is only 2%, which is significantly below the sector median of 15.3% [E74], further highlighting CYIENT’s relative underperformance compared to its peers. These findings suggest that the current valuation based on earnings multiples such as P/E and Price-to-Book ratios may not accurately reflect the company's true value, carrying substantial risks for investors.
